tasks.short: Examine closing files and file the check.

steps.what: Examine the estate closing files for accuracy.
Ensure included information was executed according to regulations.

tasks.design: The examiner examines the closing files for accuracy and ensures the included information was executed according to regulations. {DOCS} only retrieves a file already stored, then files the check they accepted. A missing document is not marked executed. The retrieve does not examine the file.
tasks.previous_blocker: A stored closing file was opened by hunting the folder before the examiner could read it.
tasks.enabler_now: A closing file the office already stores can be retrieved by its file id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the included information was executed according to regulations stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner ensures execution. A retrieved file does not.
tasks.altitude: The examination and the check against regulations stay in full. Only retrieving the stored file and filing the accepted check are shorter.

reach.task: See the closing check the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The closer does not decide that a document was executed

evidence.claim: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.
National rules differ on who may register a document and on which legislation applies. The examiner determines whether it can be registered. This file does not register it.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a closing file is stored and ends when the accepted check is filed. The examiner examines and ensures execution. A missing document is not marked executed.
The fields are file id and the result recorded or not. The closing file produces the documents. The examiner produces the result. A missing document is not marked executed.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the examination stays. The retrieve and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether every closing document is already in the stored file.
Which regulations the office requires the examiner to apply on a closing file.
research_questions: Is every closing document already in the stored file?
Which regulations does the office require the examiner to apply on a closing file?

tasks.short: Confer with parties on title problems.

steps.what: Confer with realtors and lending institution personnel.
Confer with buyers, sellers, and contractors to resolve problems.
Exchange title information with surveyors and courthouse personnel.

tasks.design: The examiner confers with realtors and lending institution personnel, with buyers, sellers, and contractors, and exchanges title information with surveyors and courthouse personnel. The calls are not recorded. Nothing resolves the problem. Nothing sends a summary of the call.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem was resolved only by talking to the people who hold the fact.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the record confers with those people or resolves the problem.
tasks.still_hard: What was said, and whether the problem is resolved, stay with the examiner in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner confers. A note of the call does not resolve the problem.
tasks.altitude: The conferring stays in full. There is no shorter step.

reach.task: Exchange title information with the examiner
reach.learn: The examiner still confers in person or on the call

evidence.claim: This design does not score examiners and does not record calls.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a title problem needs another person and ends when the examiner has conferred. Nothing is sent. Zero incremental hours are justified because no step is removed and no upkeep is added.
There is no new field. The other person produces what they know. The examiner produces the resolution. Calls are not recorded. National rules differ on what may be said about a file.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree: the conferring stays.
unknowns: Whether a party expects the call to be recorded.
Which problems the office will not discuss until the examiner has the file in front of them.
research_questions: Does a party expect the call to be recorded?
Which problems will the office not discuss until the examiner has the file in front of them?

tasks.short: Obtain drawings and file the accepted ones.

steps.what: Read which drawings the file lacks.
Obtain drawings delineating properties from title plants.
Obtain drawings from county surveyors and assessors' offices.

tasks.design: The examiner obtains drawings delineating properties from company title plants and from county surveyors and assessors' offices, then accepts them. {DOCS} only shows which drawings the file already lacks, then files the drawings they accepted. A drawing that cannot be obtained is noted, not invented. The company plant is the office's own file.
tasks.previous_blocker: The examiner did not know which drawing was already in the file until they hunted for it.
tasks.enabler_now: The file can show which drawing it already holds.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the drawing delineates this property stays with the examiner who obtained it.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner obtains the drawing. A file list does not.
tasks.altitude: Obtaining the drawings and accepting them stay in full. Only reading what the file lacks and filing the accepted drawings are shorter.

reach.task: Use the drawing the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not obtain the drawing

evidence.claim: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a property file needs a drawing and ends when the accepted drawing is filed. The examiner obtains it. A drawing that cannot be obtained is noted, not invented.
The fields are property id and the drawing source. The office file produces what it already holds. The examiner obtains the rest. A drawing that cannot be obtained is noted, not invented.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the obtaining stays. The gap list and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the company title plant already holds the drawing.
Which assessors' offices still require the examiner to collect the drawing in person.
research_questions: Does the company title plant already hold the drawing?
Which assessors' offices still require the examiner to collect the drawing in person?

steps.what: Read appropriate fields the record keeping systems hold.
Check fields needed to create title records.
Accept existing title records they update.

tasks.design: The examiner checks the fields needed to create title records and accepts the existing records they will update. {ERP} shows the appropriate fields the record keeping systems already hold, then enters only the values they accepted. A field they did not accept is not entered. A low-confidence extract is not entered.
tasks.previous_blocker: Accepted values were keyed again after the examiner had already checked them.
tasks.enabler_now: Fields the record already holds can be shown before the examiner checks them.
tasks.still_hard: Which value may create or update a title record stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner accepts the record. An entry does not decide the value.
tasks.altitude: Checking the fields and accepting the records stay in full. Only reading stored fields and entering the accepted records are shorter.

reach.task: Use the title record the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not choose the value

evidence.claim: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.
Confidential title files are not pasted into a free tool. A copy uses only fields the examiner already marked.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a title record must be created or updated and ends when the accepted values are entered. The examiner checks and accepts. A field they did not accept is not entered.
The fields are record id and the fields they accepted. The examiner produces the values. A field they did not accept is not entered.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the check and the acceptance stay. The read and the entry are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the record keeping system already holds every field they need.
Which updates the office refuses to enter until a recorded document is on the file.
